## About
John Goehle, MBA, CASC is an ambulatory surgery center advisor, author, and host of The ASC Podcast. This site is the catalog and ordering hub for his professional ASC reference books: The Survey Guide for ASCs (2026 Edition, available now) and Ambulatory Surgery Center Governance. Bulk and institutional orders are available through the contact page.
